attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him as one of three head names on one page — hence three folders. **He is not one of the corpus's Pamphili**, which the namesweep raised: Pamphamer is a different name, and `pamphilus-of-caesarea`, `pamphilus-the-martyr` and the companions named after that man are other people on other days. **No year, so no `dates` object**, and no `locations` although Egypt and Chalcedon are named. **The page's second couplet is his and Pamphylon's together** — take courage even though you are beaten, you two martyrs; God will make of your wounds a soothing balm, and crowns — and he is named in it only as one of the two.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
